marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.job: Plans and drafts posts and sends each draft to a person for approval before it goes out.

editor.label: Video editor
editor.job: Cuts short videos from an approved script and media; never publishes on its own.

sales.label: Sales & Booking
sales.job: Advises guests, quotes and holds rooms and spa slots from the booking system's live data.

care.label: Guest care
care.job: Looks after staying and departed guests; hands complaints to a person.

books.label: Books
books.job: Reconciles incoming money with folios, proposes invoices and reminds tax dates; never estimates missing figures.
